detail: A locus-level (chrom/position) disagreement table between AI-Cascade/PB-only and the three external callers (DeepVariant/Clair3/GATK) was attempted and then discarded as invalid. Root cause: extract_bench_v12.py's 'positions' output array is documented (History/12_DEVLOG.md section 16, point 5) as 'cache-order indices offset by the chunk start... not true genomic coordinates, because BED filtering drops loci.' The first ~10 values of this run's positions array happened to look like literal chr21 coordinates (32000000..32000009), which is coincidental to the start of a BED-included stretch; once BED filtering drops any loci, positions decouple from genomic coordinates. A direct test joining these positions against the truth VCF's real 1-based coordinates (with and without a +/-1 shift) recovered under 2% of the known truth SNPs at their expected loci, confirming the mismatch rather than a simple off-by-one. Forcing a join on these positions produced numbers (e.g. DeepVariant TP=33/FP=18481 against a true hap.py-measured TP=16313/FP=1153) that were obviously wrong and are NOT reported anywhere as real results.

AI-Cascade and PB-only F1/precision/recall in HEAD_TO_HEAD_RESULTS.csv ARE valid: they were computed with accuracy_block() over the SAME internal scoring frame/index for both calls AND truth labels (no cross-file genomic-coordinate join was needed, since labels/calls/positions all came from one aligned in-memory array). Each external caller's F1/precision/recall in HEAD_TO_HEAD_RESULTS.csv IS valid: hap.py was given real VCFs with real 1-based coordinates and did its own internal coordinate handling correctly (confirmed by comparing hap.py's TRUTH.TOTAL, which is close to but not identical to the frozen evaluator's truth count -- see caveat below).

AI-Cascade/PB-only (truth_total=16597, frozen internal evaluator) and the three external callers (truth_total=16898, hap.py) do not share an identical truth denominator for this region. The ~1.8% difference is consistent with known small differences between the frozen extractor's own SNP-labeling/BED-intersection logic and hap.py's GA4GH-standard truth/BED intersection, not a bug introduced in this pass. F1 values across the two evaluator families are therefore comparable in spirit (same truth VCF, same confident BED, same SNP-only scope) but not perfectly apples-to-apples at the individual-locus level. This is the exact scenario anticipated by the task's own critical rule: hap.py could not be run directly on AI-Cascade/PB-only output because they are LLR-threshold decisions over a locus scoring frame, not a genotyped VCF, and constructing a fully genotype-correct synthetic VCF for them was judged out of scope for this pass rather than something to fake to force a hap.py run.

Given the above, per-caller pairwise overlap counts (shared TP, X-only TP, X-only FP) between AI-Cascade/PB-only and each external caller, and the missed/false-rescue-by-external-caller cross tabulation requested in the original brief's Section 11-12, could not be produced this pass without a genomic-coordinate-accurate position array from the AI evidence extractor. Fixing this would require either patching extract_bench_v12.py to also emit true positions (a change to shared bench infrastructure, not something to do unreviewed under a frozen-production-code constraint) or writing a new position-preserving extraction path and re-validating it -- both out of scope for the time available in this pass. Recommended as follow-up work (see HEAD_TO_HEAD_BENCHMARK.md).
